achievement.experience: **3rd Place — HACKTECH FUSION 3.0**. HACKTECH FUSION 3.0 was a memorable hackathon experience conducted by the Department of Information Science & Engineering at Bapuji Institute of Engineering and Technology (BIET) on 9th and 10th May 2025. During the hackathon, I worked with my team on Advance Fitness Tracker, a full-stack fitness application designed to help users monitor and improve their overall health and fitness. The project combined modern web technologies with AI and computer-vision-based features, including a Yoga Pose Correctness Detector, Bicep Curl Trainer, Smart Diet Tracker, fitness dashboard, BMI and BMR calculations, and fitness tips. Our project was recognized for its innovation, technical implementation, and practical impact, and we secured 3rd Place in the hackathon. This experience strengthened my teamwork, problem-solving, technical development, and ability to build practical solutions under a competitive hackathon environment.

**2nd Place — ASTRIX 2026 – THE BUILDVERSE**. ASTRIX 2026 – THE BUILDVERSE was a valuable hackathon experience where I had the opportunity to turn ideas into a practical solution while working in a fast-paced environment. Our team secured **2nd Place** in the hackathon, recognizing our solution and implementation. The experience challenged me to think creatively, solve problems under time constraints, collaborate effectively with my team, and apply my technical knowledge to build something meaningful. More than just a certificate, this achievement helped me strengthen my problem-solving, teamwork, development, and presentation skills.

**Hack Malenadu 2026 — ReviewIQ**. Hack Malenadu 2026 was a large-scale, student-focused, industry-driven hackathon presented by PES Institute of Technology and Management, Shivamogga and powered by TestMySkills and HackCulture. The event recorded 2,356 registrations, 729 teams and 415 idea submissions with 150 teams advancing to the final floor. The hackathon also brought together 12 industry mentors, 3 IT industry founders as jury members, 4 international expert sessions and 3 MoUs with IT industries creating an environment focused on innovation, industry exposure and real-world problem solving. As part of the Consumer & Retail track. I worked on **ReviewIQ — Agentic AI A Multi-Agent Customer Review Intelligence System**, a platform designed to transform customer reviews into actionable business insights. The solution uses a multi-agent LangGraph pipeline for preprocessing, deduplication, emoji analysis, sentiment analysis, trend detection, cross-product comparison, recommendations and report generation. The project was developed using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Recharts, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph and Ollama with LLaMA 3.1 8B with AI processing running locally. Working on the solution in a high-pressure hackathon environment strengthened my skills in AI engineering, rapid development, problem solving, teamwork and building practical solutions for real-world business problems.

**NEURAL HACK **. Participated in a 5-hour hackathon where I worked with my team on VaultX — Secure Zero-Trust File Sharing Platform, based on the problem statement **Secure File Sharing with Expiring Links**. We developed a secure file-sharing platform that gives users greater control over shared files through authentication, time-based expiry, download limits, access control, signed access tokens, file encryption and activity tracking. The project was built using React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Node.js, FastAPI, REST APIs and PostgreSQL with security mechanisms including AES-256-GCM encryption, HMAC-SHA256, Argon2id/PBKDF2, cryptographically secure tokens, atomic download counters and audit/risk monitoring. Working within a 5-hour time constraint gave me valuable experience in rapid development, security-focused problem solving, teamwork and building a practical full-stack solution under pressure.
